narrative: Day 5 is an overcast, windy Sunday and a rest day for the project. There is still nobody at the Qizilqum site and the Tashkent office is mostly empty. Two managers work quietly at home to finish scripted deliverables ahead of the busy week: Planning issues the initial Risk Register and HSE issues the first revision of the Project HSE Management Plan. All other correspondence waits until Monday 7 December, when the PEP Rev A inputs fall due.

tasks: Compile the initial project Risk Register from the KOM minutes, the Procurement Plan and Package List Rev A, the Subcontracting Strategy and the PEP Rev A inputs from Engineering and Construction

Include at least 15 risks with probability, impact, score, mitigation, owner and linked schedule activity, covering the 220/33 kV transformer lead time against M10, the late long-lead specifications (Elena by 18 Dec), the geotechnical report A220 against M04 Basic Design approval, land allocation A110 before NTP, the APG and advance payment (A050/M03), construction permit M07, customs and DDP logistics through Kazakhstan, winter weather for the survey start, and grid connection agreement and protection coordination with UzGridCo
Append every risk to the project risk register and send the register to Rajan Iyer for review before it goes into PEP Rev A

Send the draft to Sanjay Mehta, since his mobilisation sequence depends on the induction regime and camp welfare and first aid arrangements
